title: anthyllis polycephala var. tejedensis
intro: Anthyllis polycephala var. tejedensis, commonly known as Tejedensis or Red Clover, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, characterized by its distinctive red flowers and trifoliate leaves. It has been traditionally used to support women's health, with its reported health benefits including relief from menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and lactation support. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis polycephala var. tejedensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and estrogenic properties, which contribute to its soothing and balancing effects on the female reproductive system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
